title: The tax myth that makes people scared of a raise
hooks: A lot of people fear a pay raise will push them into a higher tax bracket and leave them worse off.
No, a bigger salary does not mean your whole income gets taxed more.
Let me clear up the biggest tax misunderstanding I hear in Singapore.
talking_points: Singapore uses progressive tax, so only the income inside each band is taxed at that band's rate.
A raise never leaves you with less take-home pay overall, it just taxes the top slice a bit more.
Reliefs and schemes like SRS or CPF top-ups may help reduce your assessable income, so it's worth planning.
Check the current brackets and relief limits on the IRAS website before you plan around them.
